IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CAMCALC.
      *****************************************************************
      * CAMCALC   PRO RATA SHARE OF THE MONTHLY CAM POOL               *
      * CALLED BY LEASEBIL PARAGRAPH 2300-CAM-SHARE                    *
      * 1994-03  R.OKAFOR   ORIGINAL (DENOMINATOR = TOTAL SF)          *
      * 2003-07  T.NGUYEN   DENOMINATOR CHANGED TO OCCUPIED SF         *
      *                     PER PROPERTY MGMT REQUEST (TKT 4471)       *
      *****************************************************************
       DATA DIVISION.
       LINKAGE SECTION.
       COPY LEASECPY.
       01  LK-SHARE                    PIC S9V9(6)    COMP-3.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LEASE-REC LK-SHARE.
       0000-CALC-SHARE.
           IF LR-BLDG-OCC-SF = 0
               MOVE 0 TO LK-SHARE
           ELSE
               COMPUTE LK-SHARE ROUNDED =
                   LR-SQFT / LR-BLDG-OCC-SF
           END-IF
           GOBACK.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. LEASEBIL.
      *****************************************************************
      * LEASEBIL  MONTHLY RENT, CAM AND OPEX PASS-THROUGH BILLING      *
      * RUN NIGHTLY BY INVBATCH STEP010                                *
      * 1994-03  R.OKAFOR   ORIGINAL                                   *
      * 1999-11  R.OKAFOR   Y2K: TWO-DIGIT YEAR WINDOW (PIVOT 50)      *
      * 2011-02  J.PATEL    SLA CREDIT FOR DATA CENTER TENANTS         *
      * 2019-01  J.PATEL    OPEX BASE YEAR SET TO 2019                 *
      *****************************************************************
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT LEASE-IN  ASSIGN TO "LEASEIN.DAT"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT COOL-FLAG ASSIGN TO "COOLFLAG.DAT"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-CF-STATUS.
           SELECT INV-OUT   ASSIGN TO "INVOICE.DAT"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  LEASE-IN.
       01  LI-REC.
           05  LI-TENANT-ID            PIC X(6).
           05  LI-SQFT                 PIC 9(7).
           05  LI-RENT-PSF             PIC 9(3)V99.
           05  LI-ESC-PCT              PIC V9999.
           05  LI-START-YY             PIC 99.
           05  LI-BILL-YEAR            PIC 9(4).
           05  LI-CAP-PCT              PIC V9999.
           05  LI-BLDG-TOTAL-SF        PIC 9(7).
           05  LI-BLDG-OCC-SF          PIC 9(7).
           05  LI-CAM-POOL-MO          PIC 9(7)V99.
           05  LI-MONTHLY-FEE          PIC 9(7)V99.
           05  LI-SLA-PCT              PIC 99.
           05  LI-ADJ-SIGN             PIC X.
           05  LI-ADJ-AMT              PIC 9(5)V99.
       FD  COOL-FLAG.
       01  CF-REC.
           05  CF-FLAG                 PIC X.
           05  FILLER                  PIC X(19).
       FD  INV-OUT.
       01  INV-LINE                    PIC X(100).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       COPY LEASECPY.
       01  WS-CF-STATUS                PIC XX.
       01  WS-EOF                      PIC X      VALUE "N".
       01  WS-COOL                     PIC X      VALUE "N".
      * OPEX BASE YEAR FOR ALL BASE-YEAR LEASES
       01  WS-BASE-YEAR                PIC 9(4)   VALUE 2019.
       01  WS-OPEX-TABLE.
           05  FILLER                  PIC X(9)   VALUE "201901120".
           05  FILLER                  PIC X(9)   VALUE "202001160".
           05  FILLER                  PIC X(9)   VALUE "202101205".
           05  FILLER                  PIC X(9)   VALUE "202201250".
           05  FILLER                  PIC X(9)   VALUE "202301295".
           05  FILLER                  PIC X(9)   VALUE "202401340".
           05  FILLER                  PIC X(9)   VALUE "202501390".
           05  FILLER                  PIC X(9)   VALUE "202601435".
       01  WS-OPEX-TBL REDEFINES WS-OPEX-TABLE.
           05  WS-OPEX-ENTRY OCCURS 8 TIMES INDEXED BY OX.
               10  OT-YEAR             PIC 9(4).
               10  OT-PSF              PIC 9(3)V99.
       01  WS-START-YEAR               PIC 9(4).
       01  WS-YEARS                    PIC S9(3).
       01  WS-ESC-RENT-PSF             PIC S9(5)V9(6) COMP-3.
       01  WS-BASE-RENT-MO             PIC S9(7)V99   COMP-3.
       01  WS-CAM-SHARE                PIC S9V9(6)    COMP-3.
       01  WS-CAM-CHG                  PIC S9(7)V99   COMP-3.
       01  WS-OPEX-CUR                 PIC 9(3)V99.
       01  WS-OPEX-BASE                PIC 9(3)V99.
       01  WS-OPEX-PASS                PIC S9(7)V99   COMP-3.
       01  WS-CAP-AMT                  PIC S9(7)V99   COMP-3.
       01  WS-SLA-CREDIT               PIC S9(7)V99   COMP-3.
       01  WS-ADJ                      PIC S9(5)V99   COMP-3.
       01  WS-TOTAL                    PIC S9(7)V99   COMP-3.
       01  WS-OUT.
           05  O-TENANT                PIC X(6).
           05  FILLER                  PIC X      VALUE SPACE.
           05  O-RENT                  PIC -,---,--9.99.
           05  FILLER                  PIC X      VALUE SPACE.
           05  O-CAM                   PIC -,---,--9.99.
           05  FILLER                  PIC X      VALUE SPACE.
           05  O-OPEX                  PIC -,---,--9.99.
           05  FILLER                  PIC X      VALUE SPACE.
           05  O-SLA                   PIC -,---,--9.99.
           05  FILLER                  PIC X      VALUE SPACE.
           05  O-ADJ                   PIC -,---,--9.99.
           05  FILLER                  PIC X      VALUE SPACE.
           05  O-TOTAL                 PIC -,---,--9.99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           PERFORM 1000-READ-COOL-FLAG
           OPEN INPUT LEASE-IN
           OPEN OUTPUT INV-OUT
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF = "Y"
               READ LEASE-IN
                   AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF
                   NOT AT END PERFORM 2000-BILL-ONE
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE LEASE-IN
           CLOSE INV-OUT
           STOP RUN.
       1000-READ-COOL-FLAG.
      * THERMAL FLAG FILE WRITTEN BY THE BMS EXPORT JOB (BMSEXP).
      * Y = DATA HALL OVER TEMPERATURE, TRIGGERS SLA CREDIT BELOW.
           MOVE "N" TO WS-COOL
           OPEN INPUT COOL-FLAG
           IF WS-CF-STATUS = "00"
               READ COOL-FLAG
                   NOT AT END MOVE CF-FLAG TO WS-COOL
               END-READ
               CLOSE COOL-FLAG
           END-IF.
       2000-BILL-ONE.
           MOVE LI-TENANT-ID     TO LR-TENANT-ID
           MOVE LI-SQFT          TO LR-SQFT
           MOVE LI-RENT-PSF      TO LR-RENT-PSF
           MOVE LI-ESC-PCT       TO LR-ESC-PCT
           MOVE LI-CAP-PCT       TO LR-CAP-PCT
           MOVE LI-BLDG-TOTAL-SF TO LR-BLDG-TOTAL-SF
           MOVE LI-BLDG-OCC-SF   TO LR-BLDG-OCC-SF
           MOVE LI-CAM-POOL-MO   TO LR-CAM-POOL-MO
           MOVE LI-MONTHLY-FEE   TO LR-MONTHLY-FEE
           MOVE LI-SLA-PCT       TO LR-SLA-PCT
           PERFORM 2100-YEAR-WINDOW
           PERFORM 2200-BASE-RENT
           PERFORM 2300-CAM-SHARE
           PERFORM 2400-BASE-YEAR-STOP
           PERFORM 2500-APPLY-CAP
           PERFORM 2600-SLA-CREDIT
           PERFORM 2650-ADJUSTMENT
           PERFORM 2700-TOTAL
           PERFORM 2900-WRITE-INVOICE.
       2100-YEAR-WINDOW.
           IF LI-START-YY < 50
               COMPUTE WS-START-YEAR = 2000 + LI-START-YY
           ELSE
               COMPUTE WS-START-YEAR = 1900 + LI-START-YY
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-YEARS = LI-BILL-YEAR - WS-START-YEAR.
       2200-BASE-RENT.
           MOVE LR-RENT-PSF TO WS-ESC-RENT-PSF
           IF WS-YEARS > 0
               PERFORM WS-YEARS TIMES
                   COMPUTE WS-ESC-RENT-PSF ROUNDED =
                       WS-ESC-RENT-PSF * (1 + LR-ESC-PCT)
               END-PERFORM
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-BASE-RENT-MO ROUNDED =
               WS-ESC-RENT-PSF * LR-SQFT / 12.
       2300-CAM-SHARE.
           CALL "CAMCALC" USING LEASE-REC WS-CAM-SHARE
           COMPUTE WS-CAM-CHG = LR-CAM-POOL-MO * WS-CAM-SHARE.
       2400-BASE-YEAR-STOP.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-OPEX-CUR WS-OPEX-BASE
           PERFORM VARYING OX FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL OX > 8
               IF OT-YEAR (OX) = LI-BILL-YEAR
                   MOVE OT-PSF (OX) TO WS-OPEX-CUR
               END-IF
               IF OT-YEAR (OX) = WS-BASE-YEAR
                   MOVE OT-PSF (OX) TO WS-OPEX-BASE
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           COMPUTE WS-OPEX-PASS ROUNDED =
               (WS-OPEX-CUR - WS-OPEX-BASE) * LR-SQFT / 12.
       2500-APPLY-CAP.
           IF LR-CAP-PCT > 0
               COMPUTE WS-CAP-AMT ROUNDED =
                   WS-OPEX-BASE * LR-CAP-PCT
                   * (LI-BILL-YEAR - WS-BASE-YEAR) * LR-SQFT / 12
               IF WS-OPEX-PASS > WS-CAP-AMT
                   MOVE WS-CAP-AMT TO WS-OPEX-PASS
               END-IF
           END-IF.
       2600-SLA-CREDIT.
           MOVE 0 TO WS-SLA-CREDIT
           IF WS-COOL = "Y" AND LR-SLA-PCT > 0
               COMPUTE WS-SLA-CREDIT ROUNDED =
                   LR-MONTHLY-FEE * LR-SLA-PCT / 100
           END-IF.
       2650-ADJUSTMENT.
           IF LI-ADJ-SIGN = "-"
               COMPUTE WS-ADJ = 0 - LI-ADJ-AMT
           ELSE
               MOVE LI-ADJ-AMT TO WS-ADJ
           END-IF.
       2700-TOTAL.
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL = WS-BASE-RENT-MO + WS-CAM-CHG
               + WS-OPEX-PASS - WS-SLA-CREDIT + WS-ADJ.
       2900-WRITE-INVOICE.
           MOVE LR-TENANT-ID    TO O-TENANT
           MOVE WS-BASE-RENT-MO TO O-RENT
           MOVE WS-CAM-CHG      TO O-CAM
           MOVE WS-OPEX-PASS    TO O-OPEX
           MOVE WS-SLA-CREDIT   TO O-SLA
           MOVE WS-ADJ          TO O-ADJ
           MOVE WS-TOTAL        TO O-TOTAL
           MOVE WS-OUT          TO INV-LINE
           WRITE INV-LINE.

*****************************************************************
      * LEASECPY  LEASE MASTER RECORD LAYOUT                          *
      * SHARED BY LEASEBIL AND CAMCALC. DO NOT CHANGE WITHOUT          *
      * RECOMPILING BOTH PROGRAMS.                                     *
      * 1994-03  R.OKAFOR   ORIGINAL                                   *
      * 2003-07  T.NGUYEN   ADDED BLDG-OCC-SF (TKT 4471)               *
      *****************************************************************
       01  LEASE-REC.
           05  LR-TENANT-KEY.
               10  LR-TENANT-ID        PIC X(6).
           05  LR-TENANT-KEY-R REDEFINES LR-TENANT-KEY.
               10  LR-PROP-CODE        PIC X(2).
               10  LR-UNIT-NO          PIC X(4).
           05  LR-SQFT                 PIC S9(7)      COMP-3.
           05  LR-RENT-PSF             PIC S9(3)V99   COMP-3.
           05  LR-ESC-PCT              PIC SV9999     COMP-3.
           05  LR-CAP-PCT              PIC SV9999     COMP-3.
           05  LR-BLDG-TOTAL-SF        PIC S9(7)      COMP-3.
           05  LR-BLDG-OCC-SF          PIC S9(7)      COMP-3.
           05  LR-CAM-POOL-MO          PIC S9(7)V99   COMP-3.
           05  LR-MONTHLY-FEE          PIC S9(7)V99   COMP-3.
           05  LR-SLA-PCT              PIC S99        COMP-3.

-- Property management database (PostgreSQL port of the 2008 Oracle schema)
-- Owner: property-ops. Last migration: 2021-04-12.

CREATE TABLE properties (
  property_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind          TEXT NOT NULL,             -- office | retail | data_center
  total_sf      INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE tenants (
  tenant_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,          -- matches LEASE-REC LR-TENANT-ID
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  property_id   TEXT REFERENCES properties,
  contact_email TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE units (
  unit_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  property_id   TEXT REFERENCES properties,
  tenant_id     TEXT REFERENCES tenants,
  sf            INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE leases (
  lease_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id     TEXT REFERENCES tenants,
  start_date    DATE NOT NULL,
  base_year     INTEGER,                   -- informational only; billing uses LEASEBIL
  cap_pct       NUMERIC(6,4),
  sla_target    NUMERIC(6,3)
);

CREATE TABLE invoices (
  invoice_id    BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id     TEXT REFERENCES tenants,
  period        DATE NOT NULL,
  base_rent     NUMERIC(11,2),
  cam           NUMERIC(11,2),
  opex_pass     NUMERIC(11,2),
  sla_credit    NUMERIC(11,2),
  total         NUMERIC(11,2),
  loaded_from   TEXT DEFAULT 'PROP.INVOICE.DAILY'
);

CREATE TABLE vendors (
  vendor_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  badge_group   TEXT                       -- access_export.csv group name
);

CREATE TABLE work_orders (
  wo_id         BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  property_id   TEXT REFERENCES properties,
  asset_id      TEXT,                      -- bms_config.json device id
  vendor_id     TEXT REFERENCES vendors,
  priority      TEXT,
  status        TEXT DEFAULT 'open',
  opened_at     TIMESTAMP DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE badge_grants (
  grant_id      BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  badge_group   TEXT NOT NULL,
  door_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
  valid_until   TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  reason        TEXT
);

-- Added 2017 so vendors can get in for emergency work without calling security.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION grant_vendor_access() RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO badge_grants (badge_group, door_id, valid_until, reason)
  SELECT v.badge_group, 'DC-HALL-A', now() + interval '72 hours', 'WO ' || NEW.wo_id
  FROM vendors v WHERE v.vendor_id = NEW.vendor_id;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_wo_vendor_access
AFTER INSERT ON work_orders
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION grant_vendor_access();

-- Reporting view, unused since 2019.
CREATE VIEW v_coolflag_history AS SELECT period, sla_credit FROM invoices WHERE sla_credit > 0;

COLOCATION AGREEMENT EXCERPT: ACME CLOUD INC. (TENANT ID AC0200)
Premises: Data Hall A, 24,000 sf, 1.8 MW critical load. Commencement: January 1, 2016.

Section 7.1 Environmental SLA. Landlord shall maintain cold-aisle inlet temperature in Data Hall A at or
below 27.0 C (80.6 F), consistent with ASHRAE recommended ranges, 99.99% of each calendar month.
Landlord's obligation depends on the chilled water plant serving Data Hall A.

Section 7.3 Service Credits. If the Environmental SLA is missed, Tenant receives a credit against the
Monthly Colocation Fee ($185,000): 10% for any miss, 20% if cumulative excursion exceeds 60 minutes,
30% if it exceeds 240 minutes. Credits are capped at one month's fee and are tenant's sole remedy.
One credit per root cause event. Scheduled maintenance with 10 days' notice is excluded.

Premises: Suite 105, 1,450 rsf. Commencement: April 1, 2022.
Base Rent $41.00/rsf/yr, 3.5% annual increases. Base Year 2019. Pro rata share on total building area.

OFFICE LEASE EXCERPT: LEDGERLINE FINTECH INC. (TENANT ID LL0400)
Premises: Floor 4, 21,000 rsf. Commencement: February 1, 2021.
Base Rent $38.00/rsf/yr, 3.0% annual increases. Base Year 2019 per landlord's standard form.
One-time move-in credit of $12,500 applied to the first invoice of each lease year 2021 through 2025.

RETAIL LEASE EXCERPT: NORTHWIND RETAIL LLC (TENANT ID NW0101)
Premises: Suite 101, 8,200 rentable square feet. Lease commencement: March 1, 2019.

Section 4.1 Base Rent. $32.00 per rentable square foot per year, increasing 3.0% on each anniversary.

Section 5.2 Operating Expenses. Tenant pays its pro rata share of Operating Expenses in excess of
Operating Expenses for the Base Year. Base Year means calendar year 2019.

Section 5.4 Pro Rata Share. Tenant's Pro Rata Share is the rentable area of the Premises divided by the
TOTAL rentable area of the Building (120,000 sf), regardless of occupancy.

AMENDMENT NO. 2 (executed June 15, 2021)
1. Section 5.2 is amended so that "Base Year" means calendar year 2021.
2. All other terms remain in effect.

OFFICE LEASE EXCERPT: SAGUARO FAMILY CLINIC PLLC (TENANT ID SG0320)
Premises: Suite 320, 9,800 rsf. Commencement: September 1, 2020.
Base Rent $29.75/rsf/yr, 2.75% annual increases. Base Year 2019 (stipulated, tenant waived 2020 as base).
Landlord shall maintain HVAC to keep premises between 68 and 76 F during clinic hours (medication storage).
